facts.text: GoodSpace is an AI-powered talent recruitment platform.
GoodSpace is described as a next-generation platform.
GoodSpace has a unique free-flow system for employers.
Employers can post open positions for free on GoodSpace.
Employers can view responses for free on GoodSpace.
Employers can check out candidate profiles for free on GoodSpace.
Employers only pay once they want to communicate with a shortlisted candidate.
The user describes GoodSpace as the future of hiring.
